# uptimekuma_notification_clickup (Resource)

ClickUp notification resource. ClickUp is a project management platform; the notification is posted as a Markdown message into one of its chat channels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_clickup" "example" {
  name         = "ClickUp Notifications"
  token        = "pk_12345678_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ012345"
  workspace_id = "9012345678"
  channel_id   = "abc12-345"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = false
}

# Leave the monitor address out of the message body
resource "uptimekuma_notification_clickup" "no_url" {
  name         = "ClickUp Notifications without URL"
  token        = "pk_12345678_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ012345"
  workspace_id = "9012345678"
  channel_id   = "abc12-345"
  disable_url  = true
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_clickup" "write_only" {
  name = "ClickUp with a write-only secret"

  workspace_id = "9012345678"
  channel_id   = "4-90123456-8"

  token_wo         = "pk_your-personal-token"
  token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) The id of the chat channel the message is posted to, the segment of the channel URL right after `/chat/r/`.
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `workspace_id` (String) The id of the workspace holding the chat channel, the segment of the workspace URL right after `app.clickup.com/`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `disable_url` (Boolean) If true, the monitor address is left out of the message body. Leaving it unset behaves like `false`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The ClickUp personal access token (`pk_…`). Uptime Kuma sends it verbatim as the `Authorization` header, so it must not carry a `Bearer` prefix. Stored in state; use `token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The ClickUp personal access token (`pk_…`), write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `token`; requires `token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `token` until the next apply with `token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `token_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
